A cruise line’s newest and largest ship is designed for relaxation and rejuvenation, as the Norwegian Aura will feature the industry’s most expansive thermal spa experience, a specialty restaurant, and the Panorama Room, an immersive complimentary dining experience.
Norwegian Cruise Line revealed the new standout wellness and dining offerings coming to Norwegian Aura, its largest ship to date and the newest evolution of the award-winning Prima Plus Class, designed to give every guest the freedom and choice to vacation exactly how they want without compromise. The ship will even voyage to Miami, Florida.
NCL’s newest vessel will first set sail in Europe with a seven-day Mediterranean voyage from Trieste, Italy to Barcelona, Spain on May 21, 2027, followed by a 13-day transatlantic voyage to Miami, Florida.
Guided by guest feedback, Norwegian Aura will introduce more of what guests love to create unforgettable moments for families, couples, solo travelers and everyone in between. Additions include the industry’s most expansive Thermal Suite, featuring 15 wellness experiences designed for relaxation, recovery and rejuvenation; as well as Tamara, NCL’s first specialty restaurant dedicated to Indian cuisine and The Panorama Room, an immersive reimagining of complimentary dining at sea. Throughout the ship, favorite restaurants, bars and lounges have also been redesigned and repositioned to create more space and inviting places to gather with the ease to move from one experience to the next.
“Norwegian Aura is all about giving guests more of what they love, with spaces and experiences that make vacation feel even easier,” said Marc Kazlauskas, president of Norwegian Cruise Line. “From Tamara, our new Indian specialty restaurant, which expands the already guest-favorite eatery in Indulge to an elevated culinary offering; to The Panorama Room’s immersive dining experience and our most expansive Thermal Suite to date, every addition has been purposefully designed to give guests more freedom, choice and opportunities to relax, recharge and enjoy their vacation their way, without compromise.”
Spanning two decks, the Mandara Spa, beautifully designed by the Rockwell Group, will utilize the restorative power of nature to create an expansive wellness sanctuary, with spaces and experiences inspired by forest canopies, cave-like retreats, cascading waterfalls and the rhythms of nature.
At the heart of the experience is the industry’s most expansive Thermal Suite, offering 15 wellness amenities, including 11 new experiences, built around the principles of contrast therapy. Guests can move between warm and cool spaces, water features and quiet lounges to create their own relaxation routine, whether they want to unwind after a day ashore, recover from travel or simply enjoy a slower moment at sea.
Among the signature experiences is the Sensory Rain Pool, the first of its kind at sea. This immersive 360-degree experience transforms from calm waters to a tropical rainfall and eventually a dramatic thunderstorm, complete with simulated lightning effects and the sounds of rolling thunder, surrounding guests by nature in an unforgettable way.

中国通讯社福建讯（记者 颜建波 林长坤 特约记者 陈海义）今年5月上旬和6月上旬，由国家电影局发布的关于这时间全国电影剧本（梗概）备案、立项公示的通知，浙江省就有三部故事影片、一部动画影片、一部纪录影片和一部科教影片的剧本（梗概）通过备案。其中动画影片《颜乌》名列其中，这部动画影片讲述的是战国末期，兵荒马乱，孝子颜乌对亲人不离不弃，父亲死后，颜乌徒手筑坟，他的尽孝感天动地，引来群鸦相助，在战乱之中展现出了孝道光芒。
这位创作者总编辑却是一位平凡而不简单的农民作家。看一下他的简历，大家对他就会肃然起敬敬佩不已。胡友大，1967年出生于浙江省义乌市苏溪镇颜乌故里农民之家，中国作家协会会员。出版长篇小说《孝德感乌》、《提篮女》；出版长篇报告文学《踏平坎坷》、《致富金蛋》等。其中《提篮女》小说荣登2024年5月“浙版好书”榜单，由同名小说《孝德感乌》改编的院线电影《颜乌》正在筹拍中。
《颜乌》动画电影立项！浙江省义乌市农民作家胡友大特别给记者传来有关资料与消息，这部动画片是由他任总编剧，亲自创作改编的小说《孝德感乌》的动画电影《颜乌》（暂定名）正式通过立项备案。记者查阅国家电影局官网发布的《关于2024年6月上全国电影剧本（梗概）备案、立项公示的通知》上看到，《颜乌》作为此次浙江省唯一一部动画影片，剧本（梗概）已通过备案。该片由浙江卓腾影视传媒有限公司备案，胡友大和唐磊任编剧名列其中。
本片《颜乌》的动画片颜乌人物形象设计方案则是，相传在古越之地，有一位名叫颜乌的青年，刚出生时天呈异象，慈乌满天飞。战乱之际，年幼的颜乌跟随父母举家南避。途中颜母病故，父颜凤言传身教识大义。颜乌事亲以孝，遵父之崇，穷栖山洞，蚊虫肆虐，赤身相替。上天派慈乌化作人的模样下凡寻察孝子时受伤坠地，被颜乌所救，喜结良友。其父去世，颜乌手挖肩扛，鲜血淋漓，孝感群乌，衔泥助葬。秦王嬴政二十五年(公元前222年)，秦将王翦平定江南后巡视至此，听说此事，颇为感动，上书始至皇帝。遂根据颜乌至孝、群乌衔泥事迹，将此地改名为“乌伤县”, 以彰显孝义之本意。
本片设计背景是，弘扬中华优秀传统文化，深入挖掘“颜乌尽孝”这一经典故事中的文化内涵，特别是颜乌这一独特元素所承载的忠诚尽孝与忠厚孝道的象征意义，全面展现颜乌的故事，让这一古老传说焕发出新时代的新的生命力，成为连接过去与未来脊骨中的桥梁。
本片的主题是，围绕“颜乌尽孝”故事，设计整体以颜乌为核心的人物形为宗旨，再现颜乌的忠诚、智慧及尽孝忠厚的光辉形象，充分展现在故事中的非凡毅力与感天孝义之情的精髓华章。
胡友大在本片创作中，以小说为基础，将“颜乌的传说”作为蓝本，创作了动画电影《颜乌》的剧本，几易其稿，最终完成。“完成小说，他整整花了五年的时间，字斟句酌、精心打磨，电影剧本也不遑多让。”
胡友大说，剧本初稿完成后，义乌市有关部门还几次邀请专家对剧本进行审读，助力提升。本动画电影片于二零二一年年底开始启动申报立项备案程序，后在专家建议下，由真人电影改为动漫电影。
“申报太不容易了”，胡友大继续说，衷心感谢大家对他作品的关注和支持。此次动画片电影的立项是阶段性的成功，他期待着这部电影能够早日与大家见面，衷心感谢。

A Life Well Lived
 
Bill Garvin, a man of unwavering dedication and love, passed away surrounded by the memories he cherished. His legacy is woven into the fabric of our lives, and we celebrate the remarkable journey he undertook.
 
A Passion for Perfection
 
Bill’s meticulous nature extended beyond his yard and home—it permeated every aspect of his existence. Whether tending to his yard or maintaining his house, he found joy in perfecting the details. His pride in these accomplishments was evident to all who knew him.
 
The Great Outdoors
 
In his youth, Bill reveled in the rugged beauty of Iron Mountain. Hunting and fishing were not mere pastimes; they were sacred rituals. Bill shared these traditions with his children, passing down not only skills but also a deep love for nature. His grandkids, wide-eyed and eager, rode alongside him on his ATV through the serene Mountain Meadows.
 
The Collector’s Heart
 
Cars held a special place in Bill’s heart. Over the years, he amassed a collection that reflected his passion for craftsmanship and design. Each vehicle told a story—a testament to his appreciation for the artistry of the road.
 
 
Bill’s impact extended beyond his family. As the owner of G&G Auto Parts, he built lasting friendships within the Cheyenne community. His commitment to service and camaraderie left an indelible mark. Later, he transitioned to Laramie County Schools District, where he continued to contribute, leaving behind a legacy of dedication.
 
 
Bill’s heart swelled with pride for his grandchildren. Their laughter echoed through his home, and their achievements were his own. He reveled in their milestones. His love knew no bounds.
 
 
Bill Garvin leaves behind a tapestry of memories—of starlit nights, roaring engines, and shared laughter. As he reunites with loved ones who preceded him, we honor his spirit. May the winds carry his legacy, and may the northern lights dance in celebration of a life well-lived.
 
Bill is preceded in death by his grandparents, parents Bill and Betty Garvin, his sister, Sandy Lee, a nephew, Brian Lee, a grandson, Cameron Sharpe and many aunts and uncle’s who he cherished.
 
He is survived by his wife, Linda, his three daughters, Tana (partner Dave), Dawn Garvin, and Kimi La Rosa (Lisa), his 6 grand children, Tyler, Justin, Bryce, Ryan, Kelsey and Regan and 4 great grandchildren, Ashtyn, Aaliyah, Paisley and Addison.

Wiegand was on the final leg of a month long, 2,500-mile cross-country ride to raise funds for the Navajo Water Project, to help bring clean running water and solar power to the Navajo Nation, when he was reportedly run down from behind by a pickup driver outside of Salinas.
Wiegand was riding by himself after his riding partner had turned back, opting to take a bus back to LA.

More information is emerging about the death of rising junior cyclist Magnus White, who was killed by a driver near his Boulder, Colorado home on Saturday.
The 17-year old national junior ‘cross champ was on a final training ride in preparation for traveling to Scotland with the US team for next week’s world championships in Glasgow.
For those who know the area, White was riding the Diagonal Highway, aka Colorado 119, when he was run down from behind by a 23-year old woman who had drifted onto the shoulder of the roadway where White was riding.

Police have ruled out intoxication and speed as factors in the crash, but were still investigating the possibility that the driver’s rightward drift could be explained by distracted driving. Although if speed — legal or otherwise — wasn’t a factor, White would still be alive.

PRP to Treat Hair Loss
Hair loss is a common concern for many people, both men and women. There are many reasons for balding and thinning hair, such as age, genetics, health, hormonal changes, and lifestyle.
As well as this, certain medical conditions can lead to balding, such as alopecia areata. Bald spots, patches, or visibility of the scalp beneath the hair can lead a person to become self-conscious of their looks, especially if their condition continues to progress over time. In such cases, treatments are available to restore hair volume and give patients a more confident outlook.
PRP (platelet-rich plasma) therapy is a widely trusted biological treatment designed to restore hair fullness. It offers patients a low-risk, natural hair restoration treatment option, without the need for extensive surgery or downtime. At the Hair Doctor Sydney clinic, Dr Mirabelle and her team design tailored PRP treatment plans according to the patient’s aesthetic goals and preferences. Book your consultation to find out how this excellent treatment option can help you get fuller, healthier hair.
How PRP works
Platelet-rich plasma is a proven hair restoration treatment that involves injecting a blood sample into the balding site. The treatment harnesses the health-promoting platelets within the blood in order to stimulate and strengthen the hair follicles naturally. There are three stages of a PRP hair restoration treatment:
- Extraction of a blood sample. The sample is taken from the patient’s own body, which means there is very little risk of adverse reactions.
- The sample is processed through a centrifuge. This is done to separate the components and increase the platelet concentration within the plasma.
- The platelet-rich plasma is then injected into the balding areas of the patient’s scalp to stimulate hair growth.
When injected, the bioactive proteins in the PRP sample work to promote tissue regeneration and an increase in blood flow. This increased activity triggers the activation of hair follicles, causing the shafts to increase in width. As a result, the hair is able to grow in fuller, thicker, and healthier.
PRP therapy offers many benefits to patients seeking healthier, fuller hair. The treatment has seen a continual increase in popularity due to the successful results enjoyed by many patients. The benefits include:
- Increases the number of active hair follicles
- Stimulates and strengthens the hair to prevent future hair loss
- Helps fight the early stages of balding
- Natural treatment, meaning a low risk of reactions
- Helps promote hair growth after transplants
- Proven results with minimal downtime
Prior to seeking PRP to treat hair loss, you should speak to a professional to ensure you are a suitable candidate. PRP is suitable for a wide range of people concerned about hair balding or thinning. For example, it is often beneficial for men and women experiencing the early stages of androgenic alopecia, which causes progressive hair loss. It can also be a great way to encourage good results after a hair transplant.
Patients with certain medical conditions may not be suitable for the treatment. This means it is worth discussing your hair loss and general health with a professional before you go ahead. A consultation with us at the Hair Doctor Sydney clinic will help determine if you are a good candidate for PRP treatments.
After we have developed a treatment plan suited to you, we can go ahead with your PRP treatment. The procedure generally does not take longer than an hour to complete. First, Dr Mirabelle will use a syringe to extract a blood sample from your arm. This sample will then be processed to create the ideal concentration of platelets to be injected into the balding area of the scalp. Dr Mirabelle may apply a topical numbing to ensure maximum comfort, and a series of injections will be made, usually between 15 and 20. These injections are administered in a grid pattern in order to ensure widespread and even distribution.
The result is a stimulation of hair follicles and healthy blood flow, encouraging healthier, thicker hair to grow.

Italian leather — specifically full-grain calf sourced from tanneries in Tuscany and the Veneto — is tanned and finished to a standard that differs from most commercially available leather in how it develops over time. The widgetPlus package adds new features to the widgets entry, spinbox, ttk::entry, ttk::spinbox, and ttk::combobox.
The new features are Undo and Redo operations, a <<Selection>> event, and for the Tk (unthemed) widgets an -inactiveselectbackground option, and some minor fixes to bindings. The new facilities closely follow those of the text widget.

Criticizing Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs -- Why It's Faulty, and My Alternative
Updated: Jul 17, 2025
Challenging the Universality of Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs
Contrary to popular belief, I don't think Maslow's hierarchy of needs activity is objectively universal for all human beings, as it was meant to appear. I disagree that these needs are correctly prioritized for everyone, and for some humans, they might not require certain needs mentioned in the hierarchy, like safety. Perhaps there are some risks, even if social, in actualizing ourselves? What if psychological safety stands in our way for love? After all, love requires preparation to suffer.
Humans are subjective beings, making subjectivity worthy of redemption. As such, an objective hierarchy of needs for subjective entities seems oxymoronic and overgeneralizing. And yes, self-actualization may require sacrifice of other needs that appear to be more basic than the very one on the top of the pyramid, which is also paradoxical because a pyramid is built on layers... The removal of a lower layer should devastate the other needs on top of it, but it isn't the case with self-actualization necessarily (given that the opposite could be truer).
There are individuals, for example, who have various special needs not accounted for in Maslow's hierarchy, making his theory not truly universal and applicable to all people, past, present, and future. That may be especially true when these special needs are more basic. For example, autistic people may, at least partially, have a greater need to isolate themselves from the environment, and yet Maslow's hierarchy does not regard the need to be alone, as a need.
On the other hand, it attributes a full layer to love and belonging.
Additionally, I disagree with the definition of self-actualization, as it is technically impossible to fully actualize oneself, i.e., achieve a full realization of self-actualization. How come? It is possible that we are always more capable than what we might think.
Exploring the Paradoxes of Self-Actualization
According to this logic, even by asking this question, you have successfully actualized your authentic desire to find knowledge, and I have successfully actualized myself by granting you knowledge. This presents an interesting paradox: how can we truly know if we've achieved Maslow's ideal of self-actualization, AKA, in a definitive, concrete way?
The core challenge lies in the vagueness of "full potential." Logically, maximizing self-actualization could require dedicating every moment, necessary to explore any single thing that we're capable of. But this raises an uncomfortable truth: missing even a single, necessary second for this internal research, technically constitutes a failure to "achieve oneself to the fullest."
As you can tell, the practical application of realizing an individual's full potential might as well always be in the shadows of our universal ignorance of reality -- including our very own.
This dilemma mirrors the logic of terms like "everything," "perfect," and "nothing", as they are all absolute. Just one instance that contradicts the concept renders it incorrect. "Everything" can be ruined by a single overlooked detail, "perfect" can't be such if its object can be improved, and even "nothing" can't be nothing if there is something in it, however insignificant.
By the same token, you can't realize your full potential if you overlooked a single detail, necessary to do just that. Overlook it, and by the easily-damaged logic of absolution, the "full" isn't actually full, if there is a component amiss.
Therefore, the most effective solution might be to redefine self-actualization. Authentic self-expression, whether occurring once or habitually, can become the phenomenon itself, of self-actualization. In this way, we liberate ourselves from the unattainable pursuit of an eternally evolving "full potential," focusing instead on genuine and present exploration of our beings.
Therefore, we can realize our full potential by expressing ourselves honestly, without the need to research every pathway that would lead to the actualization of our potential. I offer authentic self-expression because I deem it the bare minimum of self actualization. And in logic, the bare minimum is enough to qualify.

From the beginning we learn that there is a technical problem with the Miranda warnings read to the defendant by his arresting officer, and with that opening the killer changes his story, denying that he committed the crime. Poems about Rhinos: Majestic Creatures of the Wild
The Symbolism of Rhinos in Poetry
Rhinos have long been depicted in literature as symbols of strength, power, and resilience. These majestic creatures, with their thick hides and formidable horns, evoke a sense of awe and admiration. In poetry, rhinos are often used to represent the untamed beauty of nature, as well as the fragility of endangered species.
Examples of Poems about Rhinos
1. "The Rhino" by Vikram Seth
The rhino is a massive beast,
His hide as tough as ancient trees,
His horn a deadly weapon, poised
To guard his ancient territories.
2. "Rhino" by May Swenson
He is a horned mountain of muscle,
A living tank, a fortress on four legs,
His eyes full of ancient wisdom,
And his presence commands respect.
3. "In the Wild" by Mary Oliver
In the wild, the rhino roams,
A solitary figure in a vast landscape,
His footsteps echoing through the savannah,
A reminder of the wildness within us all.
The Rhyme and Rhythm of Rhinos
Poems about rhinos often incorporate the sounds and rhythms of these powerful creatures. The heavy thud of their footsteps, the snorts and grunts they make, and the eerie silence of their presence in the wild all contribute to the mystique of rhinos in poetry.
Rhinos as Metaphors for the Environment
Beyond their physical attributes, rhinos are also used as metaphors for the fragility of our natural world. As endangered species, rhinos serve as a poignant reminder of the impact of human activity on the environment. Poets use rhinos to draw attention to issues of conservation, habitat destruction, and the urgent need to protect our planet's diverse species.
To conclude, poems about rhinos capture the essence of these majestic creatures as symbols of strength, power, and resilience. Through evocative imagery and poignant metaphors, poets celebrate the beauty of nature while also highlighting the urgent need for conservation efforts. Rhinos will continue to inspire poets and readers alike, serving as a reminder of the importance of protecting our planet's precious wildlife.

步入航站楼，玻璃幕墙明亮、大厅宽敞整洁。“这座航站楼设施齐全，让许多初来本地的外国游客都感到惊喜。”导游纳吉姆告诉记者，“航站楼的落成改善了桑给巴尔的交通基础设施，有利于当地更好地为全球游客提供服务。”
据了解，桑给巴尔国际机场此前设备陈旧、运力不足，影响了当地旅游业发展。2021年9月，采用中国标准设计、施工的3号航站楼竣工，各类指标达到国际级机场建设标准。
据北京建工集团有限责任公司桑给巴尔国际机场3号航站楼项目经理胡伟介绍，项目投运后，该机场航线从原有的20条增加到40余条，“运力提升至东非地区第四名，促进当地5000余人就业，为桑给巴尔带来新的经济增长动力”。
“3号航站楼为坦桑尼亚机场建设树立了标杆，极大提升国际游客接待能力。”坦桑尼亚桑给巴尔基础设施、通信和交通部部长哈立德·萨卢姆·穆罕默德表示，中国企业在桑给巴尔打造了一批高品质、惠民生的项目，为当地经济发展、民生改善作出了积极贡献。
“感受到坦桑尼亚与中国的友谊”
从桑给巴尔国际机场出发，沿着旅游公路1号路行驶，不到半小时便可抵达当地著名旅游景点——桑给巴尔石头城。1号路宽敞平坦，来往车辆川流不息。“中国企业效率高，施工质量好，这条路的路况大有改观，行车更加安全、通畅。”当地司机萨拉赫告诉记者。
由中国土木工程集团有限公司（中土集团）承建的100公里市政道路升级改造项目（升级改造项目）是桑给巴尔历史上最大的公路项目，1号路正是该项目的重要路段。自今年1月开通以来，该路段交通状况明显改善。
升级改造项目的主要工程内容包括升级改造主城区约100公里公路、修建两座立交桥以及市政道路附属施工。坦桑尼亚桑给巴尔总统姆维尼表示，项目建成后将进一步促进当地道路设施联通。“尤其是1号路主体工程提前完成，极大改善了当地城市面貌，促进桑给巴尔旅游业和贸易的蓬勃发展。”
记者来到其中一座立交桥建设现场时，工人们正在搭建桥台。建成后，这将成为当地第一座立交桥。“项目位于主城区核心路段，建成后将极大缓解交通拥堵。”中土集团东非有限公司桑给巴尔联合项目部总经理熊运旭说。
据介绍，项目雇用当地员工1200余人。28岁的当地工程师大卫·马萨维今年初加入项目，这是他首次参与道路桥梁项目建设。他说：“我在中企学到了许多专业技能，这有利于我未来的职业发展。”当地工程师乌朋多说：“在与中方的合作中，我们不仅收获了知识和技术，更感受到坦桑尼亚与中国的友谊。”
熊运旭告诉记者，2020年，中土集团东非有限公司完成桑给巴尔51.78公里公路项目，在当地赢得良好声誉。公司再次承建市政道路升级改造项目，显示了当地社会对中国企业的信任。
“希望未来能吸引更多中方投资”
在桑给巴尔主城区主干道卡鲁姆路一侧，蓝白黄相间的米切扎尼购物中心十分醒目。走进购物中心，服装店、玩具店、餐厅、超市等一应俱全。“这是桑给巴尔第一座现代化综合购物中心。”该项目业主代表、桑给巴尔社保基金会高级投资经理恩格·康博颇为自豪地告诉记者。
米切扎尼购物中心由中铁建工集团承建，自2020年投入使用以来，已成为当地的一个地标。康博介绍，桑给巴尔旅游资源丰富，每年吸引大量游客，但缺少现代化商业综合体。米切扎尼购物中心的建成，满足了民众和游客休闲、娱乐、购物的需求。
“欢迎你们！我的中国朋友！”接待完顾客，纳赛尔·阿里热情地向记者打招呼。阿里是第一个入驻米切扎尼购物中心的店家，经营着一家服装店。“这里的设施和环境很好，客流量很大，我的生意越来越好。”
离购物中心不远处，由中铁建工集团承建的基扬瓦尼公交车站正在紧张施工中。康博向记者介绍，这是本地第一个现代化大型公交车站，建成后将进一步改善主城区交通状况，便利民众出行。“中国企业履约能力强，与中企合作很放心。”康博感慨地说，“在中企帮助下，桑给巴尔现代化基础设施越来越多，国际旅游形象得到很大提升，当地民众生活也越来越方便。”
“坦中合作为桑给巴尔发展带来活力，为当地民众带来福祉。”姆维尼在接受本报记者采访时表示，“希望未来能吸引更多中方投资，为桑给巴尔民众创造更美好的生活。”

Straight on our Christmas wish list this year (After the Blackmagic Cinema Camera) are these two portable Thunderbolt drives from Promise, the J4 and the J2.
The larger J4 was announced at CeBIT back in March, but this is the first time it's appeared on our radar. The J2 is a new announcement from Promise Technology Inc. at the show.
There's three words that you can use to sum up the J2, small and fast. Actually that should be very small and very fast.
"PROMISE Pegasus J2 is the smallest Thunderbolt enabled external storage device designed to unleash the raw power of Thunderbolt technology. Powered by 6G mSATA flash the J2 is capable of delivering over 700 MB/s throughput while supporting volume encryption in the consumer and professional post production markets."
The model we saw at the show had a capacity of 256GB and was capable of speeds of 500 MB/s write and 700 MB/s read which should be more than fast enough for most location editing situations. It hadn't really twigged with us that until we saw the product manager do a file transfer of 20 Gig in 5 seconds, the J2 would be ideal for situations where you had to get camera rushes & projects back onto a server quickly after being on location. Maybe the most incredible thing, all this will fit in your pocket.
No word on price but the product should be available in June. We seriously want one of those.
The J4 should look familiar to any Mac user as it has been designed to have the same footprint as a Mac Mini. It is available in two models, populated by either SSD or regular hard drives.
The 4 terabyte Non-RAID JBOD hard disk model has a read time of 500 MB/s and a write time of 300 MB/s. The 4 Intel 520 series 240 GB SSD populated model has a capacity of just under a terabyte and has similar speeds to the J2 of 700 MB/s read and 500 MB/s write.
Again, no word on price and availability will be in June.
